text: "Lucenteforte, Italy. Left Venafro 1610 arr Lucenteforte 1610 Distance 3 miles. In tactical position giving AA protection to 1st Bn 178th FA."
source: Battery E, 67th CA (AA), morning report (record of events), 17 Jan 1944

text: "Vehicles and personnel strafed and shelled by enemy en route to St. Elia between 1300 and 1600 hrs on the road Aquafondata and St. Elia. Five EM hospitalized as a result of wounds received during the activity."
source: Battery A, 67th CA (AA), morning report (record of events), 8 Feb 1944

text: Moved 9 Feb from Acquafondata "to vicinity of St. Elia, Italy" (11 miles), in position 0300 10 Feb; rejoined the battery near Lucenteforte 0800 23 Feb.
source: Battery E morning report, record of events 24 Feb 1944

text: "Btry CP moved up with guns near Aquafondata. Left Pozzilli 0900 hrs, in position 1200 hrs." (The Second Platoon had gone up on 10 Feb, p0963.)
source: Battery H, 67th CA (AA), morning report (record of events), 12 Feb 1944

text: One man to hospital "Wounded in Action 1740", a sergeant "Wounded in Action (LW) and remaind on dy 1740". No cause typed.

"Starker Lkw.Verkehr in XXIII 97 ... 2 Feindbatterien bekämpft, 2 Lkw.in Brand geschossen." (Heavy truck traffic in XXIII 97 [Sant'Elia] ... two enemy batteries engaged, two trucks set on fire.) No squares for the batteries.
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: 5. Geb.Div., Tagesmeldung vom 14.2.44

text: "Mit einbrechender Dämmerung wurden im Raum XXIII 97 marschierende Feindkräfte in Stärke von 2 Batlnen. durch gutliegendes eigenes Artl.Feuer gefasst und zersprengt." (At dusk enemy forces of two battalions marching in the area XXIII 97 [Sant'Elia] were caught by well-placed own artillery fire and scattered.)
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: 5. Geb.Div., Nachmeldung zur Tagesmeldung vom 14.2.44

text: "Battery heavily shelled by enemy FA action between 1430 & 1500 hrs. Type of ammo used by enemy presumably 88's. Location of btry position believed to be revealed to the enemy as a result of (2) clip-winged Spitfires with proper British insignia"
Two men "Wounded in Action (LW) and remaind on dy". No time or cause typed.

"Kan.Bttrn. bekämpften 2 Feindbattrn. im Raum XXIII 122, 1 im Raum XXIII 112 und 1 bei XXIII 117. Eigener Verschuss etwa 5000 Schuss." (Our gun batteries engaged two enemy batteries in the area XXIII 122, one in XXIII 112 and one at XXIII 117. Own expenditure about 5,000 rounds.)
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: Arko 414 (corps artillery commander), Tagesmeldung vom 16.2.44

text: "Eigene Artl. ... vernichtet 1 Feindbatterie" (own artillery destroyed one enemy battery); no square or time. "Lebhafter Lkw.Verkehr auf Nachschubstrasse nördl. XXIII 89" (busy truck traffic on the supply road north of Cassino).
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: 5. Geb.Div., Tagesmeldung vom 17.2.44

text: "Battery and immediate vic heavily shelled by German FA from 0900 to 0930. Approximately 30 shells ... From 1400 to 1515, the battery again was subjected to heavy enemy FA action. Approx. 50 shells ... Action again believed to be result of direct ground observation." A 90 mm gun hit directly; one man killed, two hospitalized, six wounded who stayed on duty (p0630).

"Auf Strasse XXIII 89 nach XXIII 97, 15 mit Truppen beladenen LKw. beobachtet. Eigene Artl. bekämpfte von XXIII 97 nach XXIII 9 d marschierende Gruppen (15o bis 2oo Mann), zersprengte eine Tragtierkolonne von 4o Tieren u. 3o Mann, schoss 4 Lkw. in Brand und vernichtete eine Feindbatterie und 1 Einzelgeschütz." (On the road from Cassino to Sant'Elia, 15 lorries loaded with troops seen. Own artillery engaged groups of 150 to 200 men marching from XXIII 97 [Sant'Elia] toward XXIII 9? [the second digit unclear], scattered a pack-animal column of 40 animals and 30 men, set 4 lorries on fire and destroyed an enemy battery and one single gun.) Also "auffallend starke Verwendung von Phosphorbrand-Munition" (strikingly heavy use of phosphorus incendiary ammunition) by the enemy. No square or time for the battery and the gun.
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: 5. Geb.Div., Tagesmeldung vom 18.2.44

text: "14.oo Uhr 4 erkannte Feindbatterien wurden von eigener Artl. bekämpft." (At 14.00 four identified enemy batteries were engaged by own artillery.) In the Cassino sector; no squares.
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: Zwischenmeldung vom 21.2.44

text: "Gun Positions shelled by enemy art'y at 1500 hrs. Two casualties evacuated." On the form: "SW in head and left arm by enemy shell fire 1500 hrs"; "SW in abdomen by enemy shell fire 1500 hrs".
source: Battery H morning report, 21 Feb 1944 (form and record of events)

text: "Während der Mittagstunden starker Verkehr auf Strasse XXIII 117 nach XXIII 97 ... Eigene Artl. legt Störungsfeuer auf XXIII 117 und Nachschubstrassen und zerstört 6 Lkw." (At midday heavy traffic on the road from XXIII 117 [Vallerotonda] to XXIII 97 [Sant'Elia] ... Own artillery lays harassing fire on XXIII 117 and the supply roads and destroys 6 trucks.) The date is typed over: 21 or 22 Feb.
source: XIV Panzer Corps, tactical reports: 5. Geb.Div., Tagesmeldung vom 2?.2.44

text: "Battery releived from mission of giving AA protection 178th FA 1st Bn."; to the Pozzilli-Casale road 26-27 Feb.
source: Battery E morning report, record of events 26 Feb 1944
